prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong place to start if you’re choosing an individual or family plan: it says it’s an independent brokerage serving both sides of the Kansas–Missouri line, compares Marketplace and other plans, and reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. Call **816-205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

Other options to compare:
- **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** — Overland Park; helps with ACA Marketplace plans and subsidy eligibility. [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/) · **913-333-8627**
- **Apollo Health Insurance** — Lee’s Summit; serves the metro and handles individual, family, and Medicare coverage. [apollo-insurance.com](https://apollo-insurance.com/) · **816-400-4477**

Before enrolling, ask the broker to check your **doctors, prescriptions, preferred hospitals, and subsidy eligibility** against the specific plan. Confirm they’re licensed in your state and ask which carriers they represent; “independent” doesn’t necessarily mean they offer every plan. If you tell me whether you’re in Kansas or Missouri, and whether this is ACA coverage or Medicare, I can narrow the recommendation.
